_meta.description: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike Building Bye-Laws 2003 — Residential Rules

rules.title: Minimum Plot Area
rules.message: Plot area of {actual} sqm is below the minimum permissible area of {expected} sqm for residential use.
rules.explanation: BBMP mandates a minimum plot area of 50 sq.m for residential constructions to ensure adequate space for the building envelope, setbacks, and open areas.

rules.title: Minimum Plot Width
rules.message: Plot width of {actual} m is below the minimum permissible width of {expected} m.
rules.explanation: A minimum plot width of 4.5 m is required to allow proper access, front setback, and structural integrity of the building.

rules.title: Minimum Plot Depth
rules.message: Plot depth of {actual} m is below the minimum permissible depth of {expected} m.
rules.explanation: A minimum plot depth of 9 m ensures sufficient depth for habitable spaces, rear setbacks, and utilities.

rules.title: Maximum Building Height (G+3)
rules.message: Building height of {actual} m exceeds the maximum permissible height of {expected} m for G+3 residential buildings.
rules.explanation: For residential buildings up to G+3 (ground + 3 floors), the maximum height is 15 m as measured from the average road level to the highest point of the structure.

rules.title: Maximum Number of Storeys (Standard Residential)
rules.message: Building has {actual} storeys, exceeding the maximum of {expected} storeys (G+3) for standard residential buildings.
rules.explanation: Standard residential buildings in BBMP jurisdiction are restricted to a maximum of G+3 (4 storeys including ground floor) without qualifying as a high-rise, which requires additional road width and setback provisions.

rules.title: Minimum Floor-to-Floor Height
rules.message: One or more floors have height below the minimum permissible {expected} m.
rules.explanation: All habitable floors must maintain a minimum clear height of 2.75 m for adequate natural ventilation and habitability.

rules.title: High-Rise Eligibility — Minimum Road Width
rules.message: Buildings above G+3 (high-rise) require a minimum abutting road width of {expected} m; actual road width is {actual} m.
rules.explanation: Residential buildings exceeding 4 storeys are classified as high-rise and require a minimum 12 m wide road for emergency vehicle access and adequate approach.

rules.title: Front Setback — Road Width 6m to 9m
rules.message: Front setback of {actual} m does not meet the minimum of {expected} m for roads of 6–9 m width.
rules.explanation: For plots abutting roads of 6–9 m width, a minimum front setback of 1.5 m is mandatory to allow street widening, footpath, and service lines.

rules.title: Front Setback — Road Width Above 9m
rules.message: Front setback of {actual} m does not meet the minimum of {expected} m for roads above 9 m width.
rules.explanation: For plots abutting roads wider than 9 m, a minimum front setback of 3 m is required for road-side landscaping, utility services, and future road widening.

rules.title: Rear Setback — Standard Plot
rules.message: Rear setback of {actual} m does not meet the minimum of {expected} m.
rules.explanation: A rear setback of at least 1 m is required for light, ventilation, maintenance access, and to prevent building too close to the rear boundary.

rules.title: Rear Setback — Larger Plot (>300 sqm)
rules.message: Rear setback of {actual} m does not meet the minimum of {expected} m for plots exceeding 300 sqm.
rules.explanation: For larger plots exceeding 300 sq.m, the rear setback increases to 2 m to provide proportionate open space and privacy.

rules.title: Left Side Setback
rules.message: Left side setback of {actual} m is below the minimum of {expected} m.
rules.explanation: Side setbacks of minimum 1 m are required to allow natural light, ventilation, fire escape, and maintenance access along the property boundary.

rules.title: Right Side Setback
rules.message: Right side setback of {actual} m is below the minimum of {expected} m.
rules.explanation: Side setbacks of minimum 1 m are required to allow natural light, ventilation, fire escape, and maintenance access along the property boundary.

rules.title: High-Rise Setback — All Sides
rules.message: High-rise building must maintain a minimum setback of {expected} m on all sides; minimum provided is {actual} m.
rules.explanation: High-rise residential buildings (above G+3) must maintain a minimum 6 m setback on all sides for fire engine access, ladder operations, and to prevent shadow impact on neighboring properties.

rules.title: Maximum FAR/FSI — Residential Zone (Plot ≤ 300 sqm)
rules.message: FAR of {actual} exceeds the maximum permissible FAR of {expected} for residential plots up to 300 sqm.
rules.explanation: Floor Area Ratio (FAR) is the ratio of total built-up floor area to the plot area. Plots up to 300 sq.m are permitted a maximum FAR of 2.25, incentivizing efficient use of smaller plots.

rules.title: Maximum FAR/FSI — Residential Zone (Plot 300–500 sqm)
rules.message: FAR of {actual} exceeds the maximum permissible FAR of {expected} for residential plots of 300–500 sqm.
rules.explanation: Plots between 300 and 500 sq.m are permitted a maximum FAR of 2.0. The reduced FAR compared to smaller plots encourages proportionate development.

rules.title: Maximum FAR/FSI — Residential Zone (Plot > 500 sqm)
rules.message: FAR of {actual} exceeds the maximum permissible FAR of {expected} for residential plots above 500 sqm.
rules.explanation: Large residential plots (above 500 sq.m) are limited to a FAR of 1.75 to prevent overdevelopment and ensure adequate open space in the urban fabric.

rules.title: Maximum Ground Coverage — Plot ≤ 300 sqm
rules.message: Ground coverage of {actual}% exceeds the maximum permissible {expected}% for plots up to 300 sqm.
rules.explanation: Ground coverage is the percentage of plot area covered by the building footprint. A maximum of 60% is allowed for smaller plots, ensuring at least 40% open space for light, air, and rainwater percolation.

rules.title: Maximum Ground Coverage — Plot 300–500 sqm
rules.message: Ground coverage of {actual}% exceeds the maximum permissible {expected}% for plots of 300–500 sqm.
rules.explanation: Medium-sized plots (300–500 sq.m) are restricted to 55% ground coverage, balancing built-up area with open space requirements.

rules.title: Maximum Ground Coverage — Plot > 500 sqm
rules.message: Ground coverage of {actual}% exceeds the maximum permissible {expected}% for plots above 500 sqm.
rules.explanation: Large plots (above 500 sq.m) are restricted to 50% ground coverage to maintain the urban green ratio and comply with environmental norms.

rules.title: Minimum Road Width for Residential Construction
rules.message: Abutting road width of {actual} m does not meet the minimum {expected} m required for residential construction.
rules.explanation: A minimum abutting road width of 6 m is required for any residential building permit in BBMP jurisdiction to ensure adequate vehicular access and emergency services.

rules.title: Electrical Line Clearance
rules.source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 8.3; KSEB Regulations
rules.message: Electrical line clearance of {actual} m is below the minimum recommended {expected} m.
rules.explanation: Buildings must maintain a minimum 1.5 m clearance from overhead electrical lines as per KSEB safety regulations referenced by BBMP bye-laws for safety against electrical hazards.

rules.title: Minimum Parking Spaces
rules.source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 9.1, Annexure A
rules.message: Parking provided ({actual} spaces) is insufficient for {units} dwelling units; minimum {expected} space per unit required.
rules.explanation: BBMP mandates a minimum of 1 parking space per dwelling unit for residential buildings to reduce on-street parking pressure.

rules.title: Minimum Garage/Parking Stall Width
rules.source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 9.2, Annexure A
rules.message: Parking stall width of {actual} m is below the minimum of {expected} m.
rules.explanation: Each parking stall must be a minimum of 2.5 m wide to accommodate standard passenger vehicles.

rules.title: Minimum Garage/Parking Stall Length
rules.source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 9.2, Annexure A
rules.message: Parking stall length of {actual} m is below the minimum of {expected} m.
rules.explanation: Each parking stall must be a minimum of 5 m in length to accommodate standard passenger vehicles with door clearance.

rules.title: Fire Safety — Automatic Sprinkler System (High-Rise)
rules.source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 10.1; NBC 2016 Part 4
rules.message: High-rise residential buildings must be equipped with an automatic sprinkler system.
rules.explanation: PLACEHOLDER: Buildings above G+3 must have NBC-compliant automatic sprinkler systems. This rule requires detailed fire safety plan review.

rules.title: Fire Escape Staircases
rules.source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 10.2; NBC 2016 Part 4
rules.message: Buildings above G+2 should have a minimum of {expected} staircases; found {actual}.
rules.explanation: PLACEHOLDER: Buildings above G+2 require a minimum of 2 independent staircase enclosures as fire escape routes. Detailed fire NOC required.

rules.title: Rainwater Harvesting System
rules.source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 11.1; Karnataka Government Order
rules.message: Rainwater harvesting system is mandatory for plots of 100 sqm and above.
rules.explanation: PLACEHOLDER: Karnataka Government mandates rainwater harvesting for all residential plots of 100 sq.m and above. Requires verification of RWH pit specifications.

rules.title: Solar Water Heater Provision
rules.source: BBMP Building Bye-Laws 2003, Clause 11.2; BESCOM Solar Policy
rules.message: Solar water heater provision is recommended for residential plots of 60 sqm and above.
rules.explanation: PLACEHOLDER: BBMP encourages (and in newer bye-laws mandates) solar water heaters for residential buildings on plots 60 sq.m and above to reduce energy demand.
